$description: Penpot token themes; mirrors the CandleViewer DS file. Colour and density are independent axes: pick one colour theme + one density mode (6 combinations total, matching the ticket's 3 themes x 2 densities acceptance criterion). Density does not need its own token sets today because every density-aware alias (`space.row.height.*`, `size.control.*`) already carries both `.compact`/`.comfortable` values in `primitives`/`semantic-dark`; a density mode is a CSS-custom-property pointer at runtime (`--row-height: var(--space-row-height-compact)`), not a second token tree, per `16-design-system-brief.md` §2.3 ('density is a mode, not a compromise, no second parallel spacing scale').
